notes.title: Update Nov.30th 2017
notes.notes:
Update Nov.30th 2017
1. The Simplified Chinese interface has been added to the game, and it will be adopt to the game automatically if you are a Simplified Chinese user.
2. A colorful atmosphere special effects has been added to marathon mode to make the game picture more beautiful and more technical.
3. Fixed some bugs in the game.
